metaTitle: Custom Unisex Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom unisex lanyards & badges for your team. Perfect for events, security, and daily ID use. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Unisex lanyards and badges are designed to fit comfortably on any wearer, making them the go-to choice for teams, events, and daily ID use. Whether you need breakaway safety lanyards for a manufacturing floor or padded badge holders for a sales conference, unisex styles ensure a consistent look across your entire group. Choose from nylon, polyester, or eco-friendly materials with full-color imprinting for logos and text. These versatile accessories keep credentials visible and professional without sizing concerns.
heroAltText: Custom unisex lanyards and badges with printed logos, ideal for corporate events and employee ID cards.
